Longevity and well-being in older horses depend on consistent, attentive care routines.
Audience members are likely to be amateur equestrians balancing demanding careers.
Travel and professional commitments inherently reduce available time for riding.
Acceptance of imperfection in routine is necessary for sustainable engagement with riding.
Podcast listeners are motivated to engage further through reviews and social sharing.
Social media platforms like Instagram serve as valid indicators of current equestrian activity.
Narratives of perseverance resonate emotionally and inspire action among listeners.
Horse owners trust anecdotal evidence from peers more than formal advice when making care decisions.
